full_page.content:
505- Cont.
Sep. 18 Baby Wm. Gloude - 4 - spastic paralysis since birth ....
21 John Malizia - 60- of 4237 Burns Ave, blind for two months - it started about last Xmas. Enrolled him this a.m. in S.M.A.
Page 3
Sep. 21 Ann Chiuinard - 45 - threatening tumor operations in breast and abdomin. Enrolled.
John Mace - 29 - % phone .... lockjaw .... blood poison, lost leg a week ago ....
27 Harry Warren 3rd - presbiterian - navigator - 22 -"missing in action over AAchen Germany" on Aug. 17, 1943. Nothing further .... Enrolled To-day ....
Angela Scoenberg - 37 - cured of apendicitis three yrs ago, having enrolled in Ser. Masses .... Now threatened with operation for tumor. Enrolled To-day perpetually ....
Anthony Sasnowski - 35 - in Eloise Hospital from badly injured back nine months 12 Oct.
Mrs. Mary Reynolds - 33 - back from T. B. San. Kiefers - still weak . Enrolled several times.
...
1944, October
Page 4 Oct. 3 Vincent Minisci - 44 - Elefantine leg ... away for 17 yrs from confes- sion. Appointment for 9 a.m. To-day. Comes with wife and receives "St. Maurus Bl." and Enrolls perpetually. Phones to Grace Hospital to cancel appointment - as being too late - instead goes to confes- sion.
4 Mrs. Cordelia - 44 - opened for operation yesterday (in Women's Hosp.) The outlook was so desperate that the Dr's sewed her up at once and now only by miracle can we hope for recovery - Mother enrolled her again To-day perpetually.
T. G. McCarthy - 52 - went blind last June .... badly infected - came and enrolled ... late in July. Dr's in Ann Arbor gave him very little hope .... Is here To-day - sight O.K.
